material_findings.title: Fixture discards refusal status and guarantees a C3 mismatch
material_findings.counterexample: In no-ack, the gate exits 75; cycle logs the actual parent-shell wait, performs clean cleanup, sets RRC=0 and returns 2 at fixture L54. The outer case at L71 captures rc=$? but ignores it and exits RRC=0. Driver C3 explicitly requires SUP_RC=2, so the correctly observed fixture exit 0 necessarily fails that predicate. The same mismatch affects C4/C5/C5b/C5c/C6. [Fixture L49-54,L71](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/sup-under-test.v10.sh#L49) [Driver L67-80](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/ctl-own-launch.v10.sh#L67)
material_findings.consequence: Healthy earlier checks yield 11 PASS then C3 FAIL/stop, with aggregate 1, rather than the requested 25 PASS; this is static source reasoning, not a reported run. Importantly it is not a recurrence of non-parent wait127: the wait repair works, while the fixture loses its own primary status. [Driver L29,L51-68](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/ctl-own-launch.v10.sh#L29) [Fixture L53-54,L71](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/sup-under-test.v10.sh#L53)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Preserve cycle's primary rc when cleanup succeeds, override/escalate only on cleanup failure, and update the fixture pin/manifest. Do not weaken the expected 75 or SUP_RC=2 predicates. No new harness is needed.

material_findings.title: Unknown/live session authority can still be retired because the leader is gone
counterexamples: T0 L214 handles own_group_current returns 0 and 2 but not the newly defined census-error 3. With an exited Jest leader and an unresolved same-session descendant, return 3 leaves m empty; L216 retires the PID AND session, and L220 accepts .owned. The EXIT census then has no session to inspect, so the supported unknown result can become a successful empty-ownership result. [T0 L212-220](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/ctl-t0-only.v10.sh#L212) [Primitive L56-60,L82-84](../../s5-v10-t0/own-block-v10.sh#L56)

New own_collect L73 waits for an exited registered leader and calls own_retire without testing that leader's session. If own_reap_all returns GROUP_CENSUS_ERROR with a live/unknown descendant after leader exit, collect erases the session before own_census; the earlier reap rc may still force nonzero, but the final census/recovery owner has lost its active session and can falsely report it resolved. Both consumer cleanup paths use collect before census. [Primitive L72-84,L89](../../s5-v10-t0/own-block-v10.sh#L72) [T0 L172-179](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/ctl-t0-only.v10.sh#L172) [Setup L158,L174,L177](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v10.sh#L158)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Propagate census-error explicitly in T0; separate collecting a leader's exit from retiring its session. Remove session authority only after positively observed-empty session (or positively foreign identity), never merely absent leader. This is a typed-result/state-machine correction, not hypothetical kernel hardening.

material_findings.title: Driver ignores a failed required enclosure EXIT record
material_findings.counterexample: Driver L43 calls checked own_record but handles failure only by a successful log call. A failed EXIT-record write/readback after the child is reaped leaves PASS/FAIL and the primary exit untouched; its case can still PASS and finish_ctl has no publication latch. Thus the helper's checked atomic write does not by itself make the driver evidence fail closed. [Driver L22-29,L39-44](../../s5-v10-t0/controls-v10-t0/ctl-own-launch.v10.sh#L22) [Primitive L74-76](../../s5-v10-t0/own-block-v10.sh#L74)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Latch that required publication failure into a nonzero result while preserving raw child/primary and cleanup statuses. This does not make private fake-child side effects unsafe; it limits acceptance of their evidence.
